title: Vertex operator algebra (VOA) to QOU dictionary
html:
Table. Vertex operator algebra (VOA) to QOU dictionary

VOA concept QOU realisation Location
Graded state space V = \bigoplus V_n Brane tower \bigoplus A_n = \bigoplus J^n(A_0) brane tower
Conformal weight n Jet prolongation level n jet prolongation
Formal variable z Affine coordinate z = v_1/v_2 on the standard chart (v_2 \neq 0) of \mathcal{S}_p \cong \mathbb{P}^1(\mathbb{C}); coordinate ring \mathbb{C}[z] vertex operator
Vertex operator Y(a, z) R-matrix insertion at z \in \mathcal{S}_p R-matrix braiding
Modes a_m Laurent coefficients of \check{R}_{(a)} on \mathcal{S}_p vertex operator
L_0 (conformal weight operator) Reeb charge: zero-mode of \xi_q Reeb bundle
L_{-1} (translation) Jet prolongation j\colon A_n \to A_{n+1} jet prolongation
Vacuum \lvert 0 \rangle Unknot 1 \in A_0 identity of coordinate ring
OPE singularity (z - w)^{-n} Strand collision on \mathcal{S}_p; Skein resolution vertex operator
OPE channels Hecke eigenvalues q (bosonic) and -q^{-1} (fermionic) fermion action
Contour integral \oint Integration around Reeb fibre of \mathcal{R}_p Reeb bundle
Correlation function \langle Y(a_1, z_1) \cdots Y(a_k, z_k) \rangle Markov trace of braid word with k insertions on \mathcal{S}_p Jones--Markov trace
Central charge c c = 3k/(k+2) where q = e^{2\pi i/(k+2)}; relates to \chi(\Sigma_4) = -6 Bring's surface
KZ equation Flatness of the Reeb connection on conformal blocks over \mathrm{Conf}_n(\mathcal{S}_p) —
